_childDocuments_.review: ((Spoilers included in review so ignore if you are thinking of buying the game, read the first bit ONLY))This game follows your usual D.I.D (Damsel in Distress) Plot story: - Lady gets involved in something potentially bad (In this case, her family does something traditional)- She gets in trouble.- You have to save her- You save her (Depending on the ending you choose)- Profit.Game was stellar from start to finish, it has you captured with very little defense (Like outlast) but instead of hiding, you are hidden from their "radar" by holding your breath. Sound is your enemy so you must use it to your advantage. The enemies are rather touchy with sound so to the point where you bump into things makes a sound? Enemies are alerted and the game does this really well. ((Spoilers from here on))Soundtrack: 10/10 The Music captures you from start to finish and lures you as the whole point of a Siren's song is explained or indented into you throughout this game, forcing you to follow it to key items but the soundtrack is nothing to complain about. From singing to the score used for this game? All is well balanced.Voice acting: 6/10For the soundtrack to be the forefront of the game, the game has a similar problem to outlast (But outlast did it better for sure) where the protagonist doesn't say much but screams most (if-not) all the time. The protagonist, "Thomas" doesn't really do much either than: - Scream (Pathetically and mostly lackluster considering the situation that occurs to make him scream) - Cough (Rather strongly compared to the scream so it's somewhat confusing)- Catch his breath after sprinting for 5-10 steps. (Someone's very unfit lol)Elisabeth on the other hand, was a perfect example of "less is more" where she played an amazing D.I.D (Damsel in Distress) but around the twists of where she begins to be somewhat "evil" she falls flat and almost deadpan to where her "evil laughs" are tough to listen to on a cringe level. Her Singing and her voice acting otherwise? Stellar.Environment: 10/10Absolutely gorgeous, from start to finish. Every single still if you were to run around blindly for 10 seconds and stop, could be a dynamic wallpaper for your computer. It was beautiful everywhere.Dog:10/10The Dog in here is a good girl and you will love her with all of your heart like how you did in Resident evil 4.Story:9/10The game has you captured from start to finish, but the ending gives a big crescendo with no climax (or if you're generous, there could be one but it's VERY lackluster) There's so much buildup and you are waiting to see what's next and even with the ending you chose, both are very much a letdown but the game makes up for that with a "breathtaking" (lol) journey from start to "final scene" not finish. Specifically said that way, because the final cut scene isn't something to write home about either than it was really cool to see the Siren for like 20 seconds before it flies away and "all is well"Bugs found:There are a few story-locked traps in the game you must go through but I was able to somewhat "Exploit them" by accident of course. One has you fall through a trap door but I was able to get out of the trap door area before it opened. Wonder if that's out of luck or not? Despite me not falling, the scream audio still played as if I did. Another was when I was trying to run away from the uncle through the gaps you can crawl through but he still managed to hit me when I was on the other side in another room but still crawling which made the death animation start and the both of us were clipping through the wall.Overall: 8/10Great game, above average voice acting, great story, great environment. Just wish it could've been a little better on those areas.
_childDocuments_.name: Maid of Sker

_childDocuments_.review: Maid of Sker isn't a bad game, but it does get rather repetitive after a while. Luckily, it's not a long, so it doesn't end up getting too annoying, but you get very used to avoiding the same enemies throughout the entire game. The game looks great though, however, the inside locations get very tiring after a while. Would recommend it if it's on sale.
_childDocuments_.name: Maid of Sker

_childDocuments_.review: Absolutely fantastic atmospheric horror, the story is compelling and the sound design and music were superb. I definitely recommend this game to anyone who enjoys the horror genre and story driven campaigns. The game play was mildly challenging at first, but quickly became quite easy after an hour. It was relatively short, I completed the game in roughly 4.5 hours, though it could easily be done faster if one isn't looking for all the collectibles and pick-ups. There's a bevy of challenge modes as well, which add new game play mechanics (like guns) which adds another few hours to the game if the player is up to try them out.
_childDocuments_.name: Maid of Sker

_childDocuments_.review: nice game, but it´s odd because i thought that was a horror title but is not.  just a bit scary in some parts,  no jump scares to anyone :P Graphics is ok but meh for 2021, the hardware optimization is good. the enemy AI is questionable but ok.  the game is a kind of short, i finished in 12 hours doing everything i could and sometimes i get lost for long periods.the story is pretty good but the map is kinda messy and sometimes you don´t know what you´re gonna do next, ( i think developer wants the player to explore every corner).you will love the game, the atmosphere reminds me the old Bioshock 1, that very old Britain glamour is absolutelly fantastic and fits perfectly in the storyline.i give a 8.5 in 10.
_childDocuments_.name: Maid of Sker

_childDocuments_.review: This game was a lot of fun!  Its one of those horror games that builds just the right amount of suspense, then scares you out of your skin with its perfectly timed jump scares!  I did this on a stream and everyone who came out had a great time as we worked through the game in 6 parts.  Highly recommend if you want a scary game without a lot of blood and gore, but that will give you nice amount of heart stopping moments!
_childDocuments_.name: Maid of Sker

_childDocuments_.review: Honestly loved this game, start to finish. It has some flaws, such as the fact the enemies are super easy to avoid (If you spend the whole game crouching, it may take you a bit longer to finish, but you'll never get caught). The voice acting is decent, but dialouge feels a little clunky. But other than some 'technical' flaws, this game is great. I was intrigued the whole time, I loved the setting and enemies. There are not too many visual jumpscares, but due to the nature of the game's mechanic, there are plenty of sound jumpscares. It's not a terribly difficult game, just a lot of stealth. I wouldn't get it at full price myself (I think I got it for half off during a sale), but I would definitely tell people to get this game.
_childDocuments_.name: Maid of Sker

_childDocuments_.review: Very nice story based on myth. Except for one or two bugs, playgame is smooth. The tense atmosphere invites you to keep playing as you discover new things. The story builds itself as you advance with few to none gaps in it. The game was developed in a smart way, allowing the inexperienced player go back and forth through the entire map, despite the changes as progression is made. Overall, is an excellent easy-to-play terror-survival i'd recommend if you're looking for a nice fun-time.
_childDocuments_.name: Maid of Sker

_childDocuments_.review: The game is very short (my style of playing is slow and it still took me only 6 hours). The story very linear, so there's no replay value, at least as far as I'm concerned. It's almost an interactive movie. The atmosphere of the game is generally good, but that's about all the good I can say about this game. The character you play is weak, has no stamina, cannot even climb over tables, is unable to fight at all, and in general is just infuriatingly useless, without any explanation. The save game feature is terrible. The ending is poorly done.
_childDocuments_.name: Maid of Sker

_childDocuments_.review: I like this game, but I do think the price point is a bit too high for what you're getting. The main story is ~4-5 hours, and there's a new FPS mode that was recently added as well with a few different scenarios you can play through. The main story was cool and interesting, but a bit short and somewhat too linear for my preference. I also felt that there wasn't enough puzzle solving involved in the game -- I'm a huge fan of classic survival horror, so it wasn't the lack of action so much as just the general lack of things to do other than walk around the hotel. There were some puzzles, but I wish there were more, and just generally more interaction with the environment. It would've been nice to see the devs take a page out of the books of the devs behind Remothered and incorporate ways to distract enemies right into the environment. There is a small amount of that here, but you really only experience it in the first area of the hotel. Despite my qualms, I did have a lot of fun with this game. It was entertaining and creepy, and the story was awesome, I just wish there had been more there for what you're paying. I'd wait for a sale, but still pick it up.
_childDocuments_.name: Maid of Sker

_childDocuments_.review: I'm sorry but the AI is just broken. You get detected when you are not even moving and far from the enemy and sometimes you can go right past them and they don't react at all. Short game, good concept but way too linear for my taste and appart from random injuries from the broken AI, it's not really challenging and not a lot more than a walking simulator (ok a bit harder than those but still)
_childDocuments_.name: Maid of Sker

_childDocuments_.review: Survival Horror with a Twist. The game has an extremely interesting story based on a Welsh Novel from the same period, that will keep you hooked from start to finish. The AI is a nuisance sometimes but to tell you the truth it didn't bother me at all.If found at sale, it is an experience worth the money.
_childDocuments_.name: Maid of Sker

_childDocuments_.review: At first I was going to vote it down because the dull gameplay but after a while you get into it and the graphics and audio are great, very atmospheric.You have to sneak past the monsters and the antiquated save system means if you screw up you might have to replay whole sections. It's a bit like old Resident Evil games (or their remakes) where the puzzles unlock different sections of a house and then you have to backtrack and can only save if you make it to a save room.So get it only if you like that type of game and with a good discount.
_childDocuments_.name: Maid of Sker

_childDocuments_.review: The hotel is a gorgeous, dilapidated place of horror. The game oozes atmosphere and deserves to be experienced.The actual animations of the enemies are a bit stiff, as you'd perhaps expect from a minor studio, but ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ the surroundings are gorgeous. Just drinking in the sights is amazing.Oh, and it's also proper scary.
_childDocuments_.name: Maid of Sker

_childDocuments_.review: It isn't really scary, but still worth playing if you like first-person survivals. Pros:- Graphics are nice. - The music is wonderful. - The game is somewhat similar to Outlast, in that it relies on stealth/running to avoid enemies. - I particularly enjoyed exploring the 1st and 2nd floors of the hotel. Cons:- The game tends to get boring at times. It would have been better if the enemies could see a little bit, to make things more challenging.
_childDocuments_.name: Maid of Sker

_childDocuments_.review: This one was pretty good! I was so disappointed and angry with the Amnesia Rebirth I just wanted a new horror game. I really liked how much this kinda reminds a bit of Resident Evil 7 and Resident Evil 1 Remake with the atmosphere.Although this isn't so scary, it's still exciting and that works too! Actually the only bad thing I have to say about this is that it's pretty short after all. Maybe I shall try out The Dark Anthology next. Some day...8/10
_childDocuments_.name: Maid of Sker

_childDocuments_.review: I'm giving this a thumbs up because it did suck me in, despite its problems. If you enjoy "cat and mouse" stealth gameplay, where you're relatively defenseless and have to avoid enemies, you'll probably like it. It's dripping with atmosphere. The stealth works well partly because ths game has such a strong sense of place - Sker Hotel is rendered in incredible, moody detail.The main issue with the gameplay is that it's too simple. For 85% of the game, you're avoiding stupid, slow moving enemies who can only detect you by sound. The sound mechanic could have been great but the desingers only added a few ways to be heard, like walking/running near an enemie, or coughing if the air quality is bad. If you crouch-walk near enemies and hold your breath in dirty air, you'll never have a problem. If wish they'd added more ways to make noise, like stepping on broken glass, bumping into furniture and whatnot. The game eevntually introduces new enemies but they're essentially boss firghts and are over quickly. When you return to old areas, the game usually chages up the patrol path of the enemies but they never add new dangers.  The original Resident Evil added hunters when you returned to the mansion and it was scary as ♥♥♥♥. But there's little tension as the game goes on because the enemies just aren't that threatening.And yet I had fun sneaking through the creepy old hotel, avoiding enemies and occassionally almost getting caught. Just wish there'd been more to it.
_childDocuments_.name: Maid of Sker

_childDocuments_.review: An enchanting adventure through the myths of the "siren" song, the one making men losing their will. The darkness of the game is heavy to feel, like a night wave. You're in a mansion near to the ocean, but the trembling confined atmosphere evokes the inside of a sinking ship. The gameplay focuses on stealth : no weapons, your only friend is silence. The scenario touched me very much. Now I'm curious about the novel "Maid Of Sker".
_childDocuments_.name: Maid of Sker

_childDocuments_.review: The atmosphere, graphics, music and narrative elements are great but the gameplay can be somewhat tedious. The whole holding your breath mechanic is cool but you dont even need it on Normal mode, and enemies are predictable, you just crouch and let them walk past you, and even if they find you theyre not scary. Its more of a thriller than a horror, its just sad that the gameplay is so fundamentally flawed or else it would be amazing.Still a good one and done game though
_childDocuments_.name: Maid of Sker

_childDocuments_.review: Pros:- Absolutely beautiful graphics.- Dark, dreary, haunting atmosphere. You can almost feel the dread.- Excellent music selection (nothing that overwhelms or feels out of place).- Good story -- engaging, compelling, mysterious, and terrifying.- Blind enemies with excellent hearing adds an interesting dynamic to the gameplay.- The device that serves as a weapon for part of the game is rather unique. - The concept of music being either a saving grace or a curse is interesting in and of itself.- Having the phonographs not only serve as save points, but also play noteworthy dialogue for the plot.- Great sound design! Sometimes I thought I heard footsteps besides mine but it turns out it would just be other sounds in the environment. Other times, I’d hear loud creaks in the hotel, and I had to check to make sure something was coming after me.- Good ol’ doggos!Cons:- Why can’t the protagonist walk backwards? I thought this was very awkward, especially since looking behind you may be important in a horror game.- Elizabeth’s voice actress sounded kind of flat to me.- Why doesn’t Thomas speak? It seems a little strange.- The Uncle reminded me too much of Mr. X from “Resident Evil 2.” - It seems a bit too “gimmicky” that, to unlock certain doors, you must hit a switch, then go hit a button, then hit another switch, then hit the button again ...basically, you “run” back and forth for no real reason other than to draw out the game. Why not just flip all switches then hit the button? It still poses a challenge but a less tedious one.- Not sure if this is a con but the bad ending is pretty obvious if you’ve paid attention to notes throughout the game. Would have been nice if it were left more ambiguous so it would make it more challenging to make a final decision- Quite short -- maybe a few hours of gameplay at most.- Becomes less frightening the more you progress and become used to the mechanics. It's a good horror game, I think, but I don't see it being worth $25. When it's on sale, then yes, I'd say it's worth buying but otherwise, it's a bit much to ask for a game with many flaws.
_childDocuments_.name: Maid of Sker

_childDocuments_.review: Even though this game is a very short experience, it is well worth the price. This game is like if Amnesia The Dark Descent, Resident Evil 7 and Outlast 1 had a baby. The Atmosphere is almost always tense and eerie so that when scares do happen they don't feel cheap. The only thing that frustrated me about this game were the saves. at times i would be right near a save and because i made a little noise and got killed i had to replay 15-20 previous minutes of the game to finally get back to that save. Overall a very enjoyable experience.
_childDocuments_.name: Maid of Sker

_childDocuments_.review: This game was amazing! I was genuinely scared exploring the HUGE map. There's so much to explore and great storytelling in this game. To keep spoilers out of this, THERE IS MULTIPLE ENDINGS. I think it adds an element that other games don't have. This reminded me of Outlast with the different "Boss" people you see. And I found myself being super quiet myself. The sound mechanics are amazing and the fact that the enemies can't see you but can hear you adds a new element. Even though they couldn't see me It honestly felt like it lol. I was fully immersed in the story. The only thing I felt was wrong with it was the enemies, as soon as you mad a noise, it's like they instantly become unblind and just know exactly where you are lol. I really want either a 2nd part, or a prequel to dive into how this family ended up this way. I think it would be super interesting.  If you wanna pay and support the developers (which will be worth your time) I STRONGLY recommend to but if not, I'm uploading my whole playthrough on youtube.
_childDocuments_.name: Maid of Sker

_childDocuments_.review: Very aestetically pleasing game, amazing sound design and a somewhat unique story.The game doesn't reinvent the Horror genre, it sticks to the formula of older stealth and puzzle oriented games, like Amnesia, Outlast and other similar games. Still it's refreshing to see a Horror game finally be done right again.Unfortunately the voice acting didn't hold up to the rest of the sound design and with around 5h, it's a bit short for it's price.But for someone who is tired of the same old, same old indie Horror games, Maid of Sker is a great opportunity to finally play something good again.
_childDocuments_.name: Maid of Sker

_childDocuments_.review: With Wales Interactive being based in Pencoed Bridgend South Wales I thought Maid of Sker would be based on Sker house in Porthcawl I live 6 miles from Sker house.Anyway it turns out that it has absolutely nothing to do with Sker house in Porthcawl and looking at a map in the train station in the game Sker Hotel is somewhere of the Irish coast.I absolutely loved the game great suspence and atmasphere Wales Interactive have MAID a cracker and I hope there will be another or one like it.I enjoyed it so much that I have bought the game on the PS4 so now I can enjoy it on a 50 inch tv with surround sound.Its great to support a local business all the best for the future.

_childDocuments_.review: Nice Indie Game, but I'd rather call it scary and gloomy instead of horror. This is based on atmosphere and setting instead of jump scares. The plot is interesting and based on mythology. Only aspect I really didn't like - or I'm rather fed up with by now- is a lot of hiding, sneaking and running from enemies similar to "Outlast" and countless others these days. I wish developers/ programmers would stop this "hide and sneak"-theme and start with psycho horror again (as in Lovecraft's works, Silent Hill, etc.). Otherwise it's getting a bit boring and predictable. Still, I recommend this game cause it's interesting and entertaining.
_childDocuments_.name: Maid of Sker

_childDocuments_.review: Maid of Sker is a thrilling first-person stealth-survival horror game set in 1898 and actually inspired by Welsh folklore that has already produced a well-known novel.  The main hook for the game are the sightless enemies that basically turns this into an interactive version of The Quiet Place.  Most of the game will be spent in darkness while trying to sneak around silently, even to the point of holding your breath when enemies are near.  Maid of Sker is beautiful; traditionally so during the opening train ride, as we see a stunning landscape sweep by from outside and inside the train as well as haunting beautiful once the train deposits us at the abandoned station.  Even the golden rays of sunshine can hide the fact that something is definitely wrong as we make the long trek to the hotel’s front door, and once the sun goes down all bets are off.  The audio is fantastic with an amazing soundtrack, truly terrifying sound effects, and some really good voice acting even if some of the conversation choices are a bit silly.   I had a terrifyingly good time with Maid of Sker.Full review at  and you can check out the first 80-mins of the game on our YouTube channel -

_childDocuments_.review: Wales Interactive delivers another solid Horror title I enjoyed this one for the most part.  Although It doesn't do anything innovative or genre defining it's presented in a fairly polished and immersive manner. Visually it's pretty stunning albeit a tad blurry and hard to see sometimes there is a good amount of details in the environments and nice lighting. Sound design wise once again holds up with some nice original music as well, the directional sound was quite good in my headphones which is super important during the stealthy bits. Story wise it's easy to follow and fits the overall sense of dread and unease throughout, I dug the mythology and Siren folklore stuff. Gameplay is the typical find some keys hide from the baddies ect nothing exciting which is the main issue with the game it's all same same ham sandwich kinda of stuff nothing us Horror fans havn't seen many times. I was hoping there was more complex elements(more survival/puzzles ect) but it's rather straight forward and easy game taking only about 4hrs for me to finish which at nearly 30 dollars CAD isn't great value. As a die hard Horror fanatic I purchase any new Horror titles I can get my hands on just to feed the itch but if this ins't you, you are probably best waiting for a sale or passing on this one. It's a solid experience but too safe and familiar. 7.2/10

_childDocuments_.review: Honestly, I think this game is better than what I originally thought. And for the price I'd say it is worth $20. The total time it took me to complete the game was about 4 hours on normal difficulty. The enemies mechanics aren't difficult to understand once you've played for a bit, but there is still the occasional scare because of the music. The puzzles aren't overly complex like some games, and this is a little bit of back tracking, but that might be good because you could have missed a room or a note the first time. Overall I'd give this game an 8/10. There could be a little more to the enemies, especially late game since a terrible misfortune happens to your character after falling down a shaft (Trying not to spoil much for those who haven't played).And here is a quick list of things in the game*Manual saves (On hard you have very limited times to save) and saving is done on a phonograph*Music is both frighting at times and very soothing*The story is interesting and the notes you collect aren't pages long like some games.*Bumping into stuff can alert enemies (even walking through grass)*There is a dog!If you have time and extra money to spare, I'd recommended taking a look at this game.

name: Kaze and the Wild Masks
detailed_description: About Kaze and the Wild Masks In Kaze and the Wild Masks, you journey through the Crystal Islands in 90’s classics platformer style. Play as Kaze and save your friend Hogo from a curse that spread chaos around the islands. Face enraged living vegetables by invoking the powers of the Wild Masks. Pounce ferociously like a tiger, soar through the sky like an eagle, sprint fiercely like a lizard and rule the sea like a shark. Features Unleash the skills of the Wild Masks to get powers from the tiger, eagle, lizard and shark Uncover the secrets of the Crystal Islands in 30+ levels with over 50 bonus levels Relive your childhood memories of classic platformers with high quality frame by frame pixel art Pave your way through a satisfyingly smooth, but challenging platformer
about_the_game: About Kaze and the Wild Masks In Kaze and the Wild Masks, you journey through the Crystal Islands in 90’s classics platformer style. Play as Kaze and save your friend Hogo from a curse that spread chaos around the islands. Face enraged living vegetables by invoking the powers of the Wild Masks. Pounce ferociously like a tiger, soar through the sky like an eagle, sprint fiercely like a lizard and rule the sea like a shark.
